# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** 10 years old  <sub>[v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001), [v3 c28 P4](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v3 c5 P17](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0017)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Davy-boy  <sub>[v3 c22 P23](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a handsome, fair-complexioned lad with a round head covered in fuzzy yellow ringlets. He has a snub nose, roguish hazel eyes, and a single dimple in one cheek that gives him a lopsided look when he smiles.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 c25 P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Davy is lively, curious, and constantly asking inquisitive questions about the world and theology. Though heedless, disobedient, and prone to mischief, he possesses a natural knack for winning affection. He lacks imagination and takes things quite practically. He is also easily comforted by treats and food.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c9 P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c17 P31](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0031), [v2 c18 P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 c25 P41](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0041), [v2 c26 P31](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0031)_

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora were orphaned after their mother's death and taken in at Green Gables by Marilla Cuthbert and Anne Shirley. Initially unruly and full of constant mischief, Davy quickly developed a deep affection for Anne while clashing with the strict rules of Marilla and Mrs. Rachel Lynde. He enrolled in the local school alongside his sister, sharing a desk with Milty Boulter, and over time he gradually reformed into a better-behaved child. During Anne's absence at Redmond College, he kept in touch by sending letters, helped around the farm, and competed with Milty Boulter over his growth.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c17 P31](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0031), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c26 P31](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0031), [v3 c5 P17](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0017), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007), [v3 c40 P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006)_

> I didn’t hurt her much . . . she just cried ’cause she’s a girl. I’m glad I’m a boy but I’m sorry I’m a twin.  <sub>[v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>

> Where does the dark go, Anne? I want to know.  <sub>[v2 c9 P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021)</sub>

> I like Dora because she’s my sister but I like you because you’re you.  <sub>[v2 c19 P41](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0041)</sub>
